- The manager will approve or reject the leave request within 3 working days.
- Up to 5 days of unused annual leave can be carried over to the next year and must be used before March 31; any amount over 5 days is forfeited unless HR approves an exception in writing.

- Up to 5 unused days may carry over and must be used by March 31. Contoso’s 11 public holidays do not count against annual leave.
